steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Socialisation is the process through which individuals learn the norms, values and culture of their society. Primary socialisation (0-5 years): family teaches basic norms, language, and values. Secondary socialisation (5+ years): school, peers, media and religion reinforce and extend social learning. | Key Fact: Norms are social rules that guide behaviour (e.g. queuing, shaking hands). Values are broad beliefs about what is good and desirable (e.g. democracy, equality, achievement). Norms are specific; values are general. Norms enforce values through sanctions (positive: praise; negative: disapproval). | Key Fact: Status: a social position within a group.
